title: Taking a bread starter on a trip
titleZh: 帶著麵包酸種出門旅行
passage:
COUNTER CRUMB | Taking your starter on a trip

If you're planning to bake while away from home, take only a small portion of your bread starter. Keep the rest in its usual container at home. If the travel jar cracks or spills, you'll still have enough to bake another batch after your trip.

On a long journey, keep the sealed travel jar in a cooler bag with a cold pack. Put a folded towel between the pack and the jar. It's fine for the jar to get cool, but starter can freeze where the glass touches the pack. Don't open the jar to feed the starter on the way. If you normally keep it on your counter, treat the time in the cooler as a break from its usual routine.

At your destination, take the jar out of the cooler and let it warm up before you feed it. If there's a thin layer of liquid on top, stir it in. If you see spots of mold, throw the starter in that jar away rather than trying to save the portion underneath.
passageZh:
檯面麵包屑｜帶著酸種出門旅行

如果打算在外地烤麵包，只要帶一小份麵包酸種。其餘酸種仍留在家中，放在平常用的容器裡。萬一旅行用罐破了或酸種灑了，回家後仍有足夠的酸種再烤一批。

長途旅行時，把密封的旅行用罐放入裝有保冷劑的保冷袋。把摺好的毛巾放在保冷劑和罐子中間。罐子可以降溫，但玻璃直接貼到保冷劑的地方，酸種可能會結凍。途中不要開罐餵養。如果平常把它放在廚房檯面，就把放在保冷袋裡的這段時間視為暫停平常的餵養作息。

抵達後，把罐子從保冷袋拿出來，等回溫再餵養。如果上面只有薄薄一層液體，就把它攪回酸種裡。如果看到霉斑，應丟棄那罐酸種，不要嘗試留下底部的部分。
